block_shuffle: Jointly permute lag1–lag4 records as one coherent 4-record block across target windows; within each partition only, retaining internal historical record relationships and all 42 feature associations. Each original lag0 row and true target label stay untouched.
critical_limitation: These are five algorithm seeds on exactly one frozen data split; they do not represent five independent held-out datasets, and the row order is not independently verified as temporal.
decision_rule: Interpret paired-seed mean/SD together with classwise and shuffled controls. Stronger evidence requires a new independent data split and locked official-test evaluation; no claims from current validation.
evaluation: Classical 10-class multiclass accuracy, macro-F1, weighted-F1, DoS/Analysis/Backdoor recall; same original 35,005 internal validation targets; method early stops on this validation and is not an unbiased test.
independent_shuffle: Independently permute each lag1–lag4 whole 42-feature record across target windows; separately within training and validation; target lag0 unchanged.
launch: Kaggle CPU with Internet ON, dsshayan/unsw-nb15, pushRare secret authorized. Single notebook Save Version → Save & Run All.
protocol: Preregistered five-seed replication of E3 intact 444-feature rare-weighted LightGBM with two matched-feature-count negative controls. One seed42 E3 fit reused exactly without retraining.
reproducibility: Archives uploaded to unpublished GitHub draft release immediately after each fully completed candidate. Source code, configurations, true confusion and aggregate results committed publicly without per-example predictions.
